title: C++ Docs failing to publish
bug_description:
### 📚 The doc issue

There is an issue with the C++ doc build which resulted from migrating to Python 3.10:
```
(!) Unable to create the root api body: [/var/lib/jenkins/workspace/docs/cpp/source/api/library_root.rst]Traceback (most recent call last): File "/opt/conda/envs/py_3.10/lib/python3.10/site-packages/exhale/graph.py", line 3263, in generateAPIRootBody self.generateUnabridgedAPI() File "/opt/conda/envs/py_3.10/lib/python3.10/site-packages/exhale/graph.py", line 3628, in generateUnabridgedAPI from collections import MutableMapping ImportError: cannot import name 'MutableMapping' from 'collections' (/opt/conda/envs/py_3.10/lib/python3.10/collections/**init**.py) make: *** [Makefile:27: html] Error 1
````

### Suggest a potential alternative/fix

The issue is likely related to the old version of exhale==0.2.3 that we use. However, upgrading to 0.3.7 results in a build running for 5 hours and still being cancelled in the end. We have attempted to migrate to workers that have more memory ([PR](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/162774/files))but it still times out.

This will affect 2.9 release. 

cc @ezyang @gchanan @zou3519 @kadeng @msaroufim @sekyondaMeta @AlannaBurke @malfet @clee2000 @albanD
